trades.rationale: FUNDAMENTAL: Fox Corporation trades at a compelling forward P/E of 10.94 with PEG of 1.15 despite 28.1% revenue growth and a 25.2% operating margin — this is a quality media franchise (news, sports rights) being priced cheaply relative to cash generation ($2.0B operating CF). The business benefits from live sports rights that are structurally insulated from streaming disruption. Analyst EPS revisions are positive (+1.9% in 60 days). D/E of 64 is manageable. TECHNICAL: Price is in a confirmed uptrend, sitting at 57% of the 52-week range — mid-range basing, not an extended late-cycle entry. Price is only +1.4% above both SMA50 and SMA200, meaning we are buying near the base of a fresh trend rather than chasing. SMA50 slope is +9.3% — trend is accelerating. Stop at 2x ATR provides a clean $60.25 level below recent consolidation. Earnings are 35 days out, providing a window for the position to develop.
